mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.15% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns from the current date are negative (i.e., SPX closes lower than at the decision time).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0 AND INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy is expected to suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a weakening real estate market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 230, it signals persistent inflation that triggers short-term equity market sell-offs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which is expected to reduce corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1000.
